illustration.description: Minimalist flat vector illustration on a light off-white background: a tall vertical measuring ruler standing upright with a light grey-lavender body, dark grey outline and evenly spaced tick marks, casting a faint soft shadow at its base; to its right, a large green (olive-lime) checkmark inside a thin green circle outline, clean rounded strokes, soft modern flat style, calm and clean lighting, plenty of negative space.

graphics.description: Dashed horizontal line running across the bottom with a right-pointing open arrowhead at the end
Green checkmark with thin circular outline, indicating a positive sign
Vertical measuring ruler with dark grey outline, light lavender-grey fill, and tick marks
